name: List All Owner Groups
description: Returns all property owner groups that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by the unique identifier of the owner group. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter owner groups last updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Number of results per page. Default is 1000.

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the owner group

responseFields.name: data[].Current
responseFields.description: The current owner(s) of the properties in the property group

responseFields.name: data[].FiscalYearEnd
responseFields.description: The month number representing the end of the fiscal year

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date owners groups details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].Owners
responseFields.description: List of owners within an ownership group

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Unique identifier an owner within an owner group. UUID format e.g. "38a5a5bb-dc30-49a2-b175-1de0d1488c43"

attributes.name: ContractExpiration
attributes.description: The date when the owner's contract expires. The date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.

attributes.name: CompanyName
attributes.description: Optional display name of the owner's company

attributes.name: Link
attributes.description: A link to the owner's page in the AppFolio Property Manager.

attributes.name: MaintenanceNotes
attributes.description: Maintenance notes for the properties owned

attributes.name: HiddenAt
attributes.description: When the owner group was labeled no longer active by an AppFolio Property Manager user. Valid format is in ISO 8601 format: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ" e.g. "2022-06-00T12:00:00Z". The default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

attributes.name: IsCompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the owner identifies as a company

attributes.name: Address1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the owner

attributes.name: Address2
attributes.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the owner

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: The city where the owner is located

attributes.name: State
attributes.description: The state where the owner is located

attributes.name: Zip
attributes.description: The zip code where the owner is located

attributes.name: CountryCode
attributes.description: The country code of the owner (e.g. "JP" for Japan)

attributes.name: PercentOwned
attributes.description: The percentage of ownership assigned to this owner. The sum of PercentOwned across all owners must equal 100%.

responseFields.name: data[].OwnerPacketBasis
responseFields.description: The accounting method used for owner packet calculations. Valid values are "Cash" or "Accrual".

responseFields.name: data[].PaymentType
responseFields.description: The type of payment distribution for the owners. Valid values are "Net Income" or "Flat".

responseFields.name: data[].PaymentAmount
responseFields.description: The fixed payment amount to distribute to owners. This value is required when PaymentType is "Flat".

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with all owners within the owner group

responseFields.name: data[].StartDate
responseFields.description: The date when this ownership group becomes effective. The date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format and cannot be set in the future.

responseFields.name: data[].ReserveFunds
responseFields.description: The amount of funds to maintain in reserve for the property

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
